messages:
sam-sales: Heads-up: MediSure asked for a one-page appendix for tomorrow's SOW signing. Key ask: recommended reserved GPU commitment + autoscale/burst guidance. They shared a traffic sketch: brief spikes to ~1.1k RPS, 95th ~750 RPS, avg ~80 tokens/resp (mostly short chat). HIPAA mandatory (Private). Can we land a short tradeoff recommendation?

nora-eng: quick math: 1.1k * 80 = 88k tokens/s peak. Measured throughput on redwood-3-medium quantized ~14k tok/s/GPU under target latencies, so peak rough = 88k/14k = 6.3 -> round up to 7 GPUs if assuming continuous peak.

nora-eng: practical options:
- Gold (availability-first): reserve 7 GPUs, autoscale ceiling 9, AZ spread 3-way.
- Silver (cost-first): reserve 4 GPUs + guaranteed burst credits to 10 for short windows, plus aggressive preheat and KV warmup.

diego-ml: model variance: quantized + KV caching typically yields +15-25% effective throughput. If MediSure accepts our quantized profile and we run KV warmup, Silver can be safe. If they need full-precision, add 25% capacity to Gold (so plan for 9 GPUs).

nora-eng: autoscale policy suggestion: min_reserved = quoted reserve (4 or 7), max = 10, scale-up trigger = sustained queue growth >25% for 20s OR observed p95 latency > target, scale-down wait = 3m. Also recommend burst-credit pool with 30min replenishment policy for repeated spikes.

rene-security: HIPAA checklist: Private deployment only, customer-managed KMS with CMKs, signed BAA, audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM, retention settings in the SOW (we suggest 1y by default). No spot for Gold; Silver may use spot for burst if customer signs eviction consent.

sam-sales: good split. Can we include monthly cost examples for both tiers so legal has a number? Keep it simple.

acct-bot: internal unit costs (internal only): reserved GPU = $3.20/hr. Burst-credit hourly-equivalent (short spike amortized) ~ $0.95/hr. Monthly examples (30d): Gold = 7*24*30*3.20 = $16,128/mo base. Silver = 4*24*30*3.20 = $9,216/mo base + burst spend variable. Example burst scenario (2h/day at +6 GPUs via burst credits) ~ 6*2*30*0.95 = $342/mo extra (approx).

tess-se: I'll own the ops appendix and smoke test. Preheat run items (short list) to include in appendix: 1) KV warmup for top N prefixes, 2) precompile kernels for expected seq_len, 3) 10m smoke at 50% of target per-GPU then 3m spike to peak, 4) record p95/p99 and token/s. Add acceptance: p95 within SLA and token/s >= expected baseline.

ci-bot: smoke test scheduled: 2024-06-12T07:00Z -> /infra/smoke-tests/1766664321. Assigned: @nora-eng.

sam-sales: perfect. Please drop a 1-page Gold/Silver appendix + short security bullets in /deals/medisure/ by EOD so I can attach to SOW. I'll mark Silver as "cost-optimized with required preheat" and Gold as "availability-first reserved".

nora-eng: will drop appendix and link smoke test results here after run. If eval on quantized variant passes, recommend Silver; otherwise Gold in SOW.
